notes.title: Dead Pixels from 2012 gets a surprise update with Linux and Steam Deck support
notes.content:
Developer CSR-Studios are currently working on Dead Pixels II but they decided to give the original Dead Pixels from 2012 a surprise upgrade. This comes with Native Linux support and they're hoping to see it Steam Deck Verified.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/04/dead-pixels-from-2012-gets-a-surprise-update-with-linux-and-steam-deck-support/

notes.title: Dead Pixels Ver 1.4
notes.content:
A new update to Dead Pixels is making its way across the internet to everyone.

[b]The big changes are[/b]
[list]
[*]Moving to new frameworks (FNA and Facepunch.Steamworks).
[*]Native Linux build for Steamdeck and linux computers.
[*]Launcher removed with options instead in game.
[*]New look to in game menus (Can be turned off in the options).
[*]A few small bug fixes but most of the game is the way it always has been.
[*]Custom game mode added
[/list]

[b]New Menus[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4298814/ce1235dd57b5ab1e36956158fe3849c0e8c9df9a.png[/img]

[b]Custom Game Mode[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4298814/ff8ea8de957b4b1765863eb829f57a127a2cd832.png[/img]
The custom game mode has a variety of new option for those that want a challenge or a more relaxed but long game.

[b]Steam Deck[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4298814/c3254297e95c01afd09f31a08004fb31fd2bdb03.jpg[/img]
A lot of the changes have an effect on the SteamDeck. I've requested a review and hoping to get the game marked as SteamDeck Verified soon.

[b]The Old XNA Version[/b]
There are some small things that have been lost in this change like windows XP support and some control pad support has been removed/changed.
I have moved the old version to a beta branch, so people can still access it if they want.

[b]Dead Pixels II Demo[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/974510/
For those that didn't see Dead Pixels has a new demo on Steam. This one has the daily mode available so every day you can try a random run and compete to see who is the quickest at making it through.

[b]Dead Pixels 1's future[/b]
If any new bugs appear in the new build I will do my best to get them sorted ASAP.
There are no plans to add more features just now, but I may return to it one day.

Until next time
Stay Awesome Everyone
John
